features: Dual-optical full-color audio bullet camera, 1T (1.0 TOPS) AI computing power
Supports 50m infrared light and 30m white (full-color) light illumination distance
Behavior analysis: fast movement/tripwire crossing/intrusion/area entry-exit/loitering/parking detection
Crowd flow analysis: queue length/head counting/crowd flow statistics/attendance
B/W minimum illumination 0.01 Lux (F1.2, AGC ON, 1/30s shutter)
Built-in microphone with sound pickup; one-channel LINE OUT audio output supported
ONVIF Profile S/G/T/M; SDK and REST API (proprietary protocol); GA/T 1400 support
Secure boot, 802.1X authentication, HTTPS digital certificate
Equipment anti-corrosion Class C; 4kV surge protection
release_notes: WDR is stated as "120 dB super WDR" on the Features summary page but as "130db" in the Technical Specifications table; the table value (130dB) was recorded as primary. WDR value itself was omitted from structured fields as there is no schema field for it, but is noted here for accuracy.
